item.text: The test suite passed. I’m pulling line numbers for the changed areas so I can summarize exactly what changed and point you to the implementation and new coverage.

  - text comparison otherwise
  - header preservation and input row order preservation: [src/Slice/CsvColumnSelector.cs](file:///tmp/codex-implement-03.CREC2J/project/src/Slice/CsvColumnSelector.cs#L81-L248)
- Added focused tests for:
